description: This script connects to a MongoDB database, lists all collections, and displays up to 10 documents from each collection for inspection. It handles connection setup, error handling, and provides detailed output about the database environment.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Prints a formatted section header to organize output.

methods.name: maskMongoUri
methods.description: Masks sensitive credentials in a MongoDB URI for safe logging.

methods.name: dbNameFromUriPath
methods.description: Extracts the database name from the URI path component.

methods.name: fetchFirstNFromCollection
methods.description: Fetches the first N documents from a specified collection.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the connection, listing, and display of database collections and documents.
